description: Daily trading-date index (parquet index column). NYSE business calendar; spans 2000-01-03 through 2025-12-31.
CME Gold continuous front-month futures close, USD per troy ounce.
CME Copper continuous front-month futures close, USD per pound. Higher = stronger industrial demand.
SPDR Gold Trust adjusted close — ETF cross-check for gold price.
US Copper Index Fund adjusted close — ETF cross-check for copper. Limited pre-2011 history.
Industrial Select Sector SPDR ETF adjusted close. Target asset.
SPDR S&P 500 ETF adjusted close, cross-check target.
CBOE Volatility Index, regime overlay.
ICE US Dollar Index — USD vs basket of 6 currencies. Strong USD typically pressures both gold and copper prices.
Primary indicator. gold ($/oz) / copper ($/lb). Higher = risk-off (gold up vs copper down). Dimensionless after the unit cancellation by ratio convention.
ETF cross-check: GLD/CPER. Useful for post-2011 consistency check against futures-based ratio.
Natural log of gold_copper_ratio. Better-distributed for stationarity and modeling.
Standardized gold_copper_ratio vs trailing 126-day rolling mean/std. Higher z = ratio elevated vs recent history = risk-off.
Standardized gold_copper_ratio vs trailing 252-day rolling mean/std. Higher z = ratio elevated vs recent history = risk-off.
Standardized gold_copper_ratio vs trailing 504-day rolling mean/std. Higher z = ratio elevated vs recent history = risk-off.
Percentile rank (0-1) of ratio within trailing 504-day window.
Percentile rank (0-1) of ratio within trailing 1260-day window.
5-trading-day percent-change of gold_copper_ratio. Positive = ratio rising = increasing risk-off.
21-trading-day percent-change of gold_copper_ratio. Positive = ratio rising = increasing risk-off.
63-trading-day percent-change of gold_copper_ratio. Positive = ratio rising = increasing risk-off.
126-trading-day percent-change of gold_copper_ratio. Positive = ratio rising = increasing risk-off.
21-trading-day level difference of gold_copper_ratio.
63-trading-day level difference of gold_copper_ratio.
252-trading-day level difference of gold_copper_ratio.
Change in 21d rate-of-change (second-difference proxy). Captures inflection in the ratio trajectory.
21-day annualized realized vol of daily ratio percent-changes. Decimal (0.30 = 30% annualized).
1-day percent return of XLI as decimal.
